intentStack.statement: A game is made of pages rather than rows holding whole documents.
intentStack.workingMemory: Every game is imported: 45 entity, 24 location and 11 encounter pages, by `akasha game import --game <game>`, which leaves a page already filed as it is. Left: fill each encounter's gates from its prose; point the gm-context and resolution-mechanism at the pages; take entities, characters and tower-floors off the game page type; then states, turns and tower-sessions go, the log becomes a system-window record on the turn page and a session number lands there.
